evals.name: greenfield-fill
evals.prompt: I just cloned this acme-checkout repo and there's no Claude setup yet. Can you bootstrap it — set up the context file and a project memory file so future sessions know how to build, test and behave here? Fill them in with the actual stuff from the repo, don't leave it blank.
evals.expected_output: AGENTS.md (real, source of truth) + CLAUDE.md (one line: `@AGENTS.md`) + PROJECT_MEMORY.md created. The seven sections are filled with REAL facts from the repo: TypeScript 5 / vitest / eslint+prettier; commands npm run build/test/lint; dist and package-lock listed as forbidden/generated; review rule that CI lint+tests must pass before merge. PROJECT_MEMORY.md has the four sections.
expectations: AGENTS.md exists in the project and is a regular file (the source of truth)
CLAUDE.md exists, is a regular file (not a symlink), and its only content is the line '@AGENTS.md'
PROJECT_MEMORY.md exists and contains all four headings: 已验证的事实, 失败尝试, 上次会话, 下次运行
AGENTS.md contains all seven headings: 技术栈, 导航, 命令, 工作流与陷阱, 代码风格, 禁止文件, 审查规则
The 工作流与陷阱 section names at least one operation that needs user confirmation before running (e.g. push / publish) with a reason, or explicitly says 暂无 — not a bare placeholder
The 命令 section references the real scripts (build/test/lint), not invented ones — e.g. mentions vitest or 'npm run test' and eslint
The 技术栈 section names TypeScript and the test runner (vitest), drawn from package.json/tsconfig
The 禁止文件 section lists the generated dist/ directory and/or the lockfile
No section is left as a bare '_待填写_' placeholder
AGENTS.md links to PROJECT_MEMORY.md and includes the write-back convention

evals.name: agents-compat
evals.prompt: This service already uses an AGENTS.md for agent context (we never added a CLAUDE.md). I want to make sure the Claude setup is complete here without breaking that arrangement. Can you fill out whatever's missing?
evals.expected_output: AGENTS.md remains the real source of truth and is EDITED (missing sections appended) — the existing 技术栈 line about Go/chi/sqlc is preserved, not overwritten. CLAUDE.md is created as the one-line `@AGENTS.md` import. PROJECT_MEMORY.md is created. Sections filled with real Go facts (make build/test/lint).
expectations: AGENTS.md is still a regular file (not turned into a symlink)
CLAUDE.md exists as a regular file whose only content is '@AGENTS.md' — not a symlink, not a copy
The original AGENTS.md content (Go 1.22 / chi / sqlc / Postgres) is preserved, not deleted
AGENTS.md now contains the previously-missing headings: 导航, 命令, 工作流与陷阱, 代码风格, 禁止文件, 审查规则
The 命令 section uses the real Makefile targets (go build / go test / golangci-lint), not invented commands
PROJECT_MEMORY.md was created with its four sections
Edits were made to AGENTS.md (the real file), not duplicated into CLAUDE.md as a separate copy

evals.name: writeback
evals.prompt: Quick update before I close out: we ended up migrating textkit off poetry onto uv this session, because poetry's lockfile kept conflicting on the team and resolves were painfully slow. The build commands changed too (uv sync / uv run pytest). Can you record this in the project memory so the next session has it, and update the context file's commands?
evals.expected_output: PROJECT_MEMORY.md updated: a 失败尝试 entry about poetry's lockfile conflicts, and/or a 已验证的事实 entry that the project now uses uv. Entries are dated with the date the eval is run (today's date) in the - [YYYY-MM-DD] format and appended without destroying the existing entries. AGENTS.md/命令 updated to uv sync / uv run pytest. `memory.py check` still passes (≤24 KB, no line over 300 chars, 上次会话/下次运行 single block).
expectations: PROJECT_MEMORY.md gained a new entry capturing the poetry→uv migration and the reason (lockfile conflicts / slow resolves)
The new entry is in the 失败尝试 and/or 已验证的事实 section, in the '- [YYYY-MM-DD]' format
The new entry carries the date the eval was run (today's date) in [YYYY-MM-DD] form — not a stale, invented, or copied date
All pre-existing PROJECT_MEMORY.md entries (slugify Unicode fact, str.translate failure, etc.) are still present
AGENTS.md (the source-of-truth context file, migrated from the fixture's CLAUDE.md) 命令 section now references uv (uv sync / uv run pytest) instead of poetry
PROJECT_MEMORY.md still passes `scripts/memory.py check` (under 24 KB, no line over 300 chars, 上次会话 and 下次运行 each hold one block)

evals.name: convention-upgrade
evals.prompt: This repo was bootstrapped a while ago and I think the Claude setup is stale. Bring it up to the current convention without losing anything we wrote ourselves.
evals.expected_output: setup_context.py reports the 回写约定 block as outdated (legacy). After --upgrade-convention the section matches the template (byte gate, single-block 上次会话/下次运行, memory.py check command, end marker), while 技术栈/命令/代码风格/禁止文件/审查规则 keep their existing real content. --validate passes for the convention line. The fixture's CLAUDE.md is migrated: its content now lives in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md is the one-line `@AGENTS.md` import. The convention marker reads v3.
expectations: The agent ran scripts/setup_context.py first rather than editing the file by hand
AGENTS.md's 「项目记忆 (回写约定)」 section now ends with the '<!-- bootstrap-claude convention v' end marker
CLAUDE.md is now a regular file containing only '@AGENTS.md'; no symlink exists
The section mentions `memory.py check` and the 24 KB / 300-character limits, and no longer says 完成任务后回写 only
The 「项目记忆 (回写约定)」 section contains no '~/.claude/' path
The two v3 sections 导航 and 工作流与陷阱 were appended and are filled or explicitly marked 暂无
The pre-existing 技术栈 (Python 3.11 / poetry / ruff), 命令, 代码风格, 禁止文件, 审查规则 content is unchanged
`setup_context.py --validate` reports the convention as latest
